dimensions.description: The site an examination happened at, named rather than coded. Bound to all three releases, each through its own sites table. An EMPTY site is an examination the network did not perform — known only from an outside report — and it carries no preparation score of its own.

Which clinical network a count belongs to. THE CROSS-SOURCE DIMENSION: the same dimension is bound to all three releases on `network_key`, so "by network" means the same thing in each of them and a question that covers all three groups by this column.
The kind of examination. The first three are colonoscopies; a preparation or adenoma rate is computed over those and not over all five.

metrics.displayName: Cypress Bay Digestive Health: adenoma detection rate
metrics.description: Adenomas among examinations whose preparation was adequate. Derived, and it stays inside this network's release — the model requires a derived metric to stay within one dataset, and each release is a separate gated connection, so there is no single pooled rate to define. Ask for this metric once per network and compare the three.

metrics.displayName: Cypress Bay Digestive Health: Examinations with adequate preparation
metrics.description: Structured examinations with a recorded BBPS total of 6 or more. The DENOMINATOR of an adenoma detection rate.

metrics.displayName: Cypress Bay Digestive Health: Of those, with an adenoma
metrics.description: Examinations that had both an adequate recorded preparation and at least one adenoma. The NUMERATOR that goes with the denominator above.

metrics.displayName: Cypress Bay Digestive Health: Excluded for a missing preparation score
metrics.description: Structured examinations with no BBPS total at all. The size of the exclusion — quote it beside any preparation-qualified rate.
